userStories.title: cam-ship Step 3 guidance for a check:all ratchet failure: raise-and-retry before opening the PR
userStories.description: As an orchestrator hitting a legitimate ratchet failure (file-size ceiling or coverage floor) during the new check:all ship gate, I need Step 3 to instruct raising the ceiling/floor with the current issue tracker ref then re-running check:all BEFORE opening the PR, so that a legitimate growth never dead-ends the ship and the runbook documents the new gate + procedure.
acceptanceCriteria: cam-ship.md Step 3 documents that a check:all ratchet failure on LEGITIMATE growth is fixed by raising the ceiling in scripts/file-size-budget.json (or the floor in scripts/coverage-budget.json) with the current issue's tracker ref in the `_ref` field, then re-running `bun run check:all`, before opening the PR.
